content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. It has no lodash import left, because es-toolkit covers all three functions. The exported signatures are unchanged.

- **`tokens`:** `words` from `es-toolkit` replaces lodash `words`. I compared it with the compat version on a dozen inputs and got the same output on each. Those covered `Id_MAX `, an empty string, `XMLHttp2Request`, `a1b2`, `IDs` and `iOS 9`. I didn't compare against lodash itself, since lodash isn't installed. The expected values come from lodash's documented behaviour.
- **`byAge`:** `groupBy` from `es-toolkit` with `(row) => row.age` replaces `groupBy(rows, 'age')`. The numeric ages become string keys, as they did before.
- **`isBlank`:** `isEmpty` from `es-toolkit/compat`. The main `es-toolkit` build only has `isEmptyObject`, which doesn't treat numbers, booleans, strings or arrays the way lodash `isEmpty` does, so the compat version is the one that keeps the behaviour.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` reports 701 bytes min+gzip, with 87 bytes of my own code. I couldn't measure the original for comparison because lodash isn't installed.

`tsc --noEmit` reports errors only in `src/module.ts`, which can't find the lodash modules. It reported none for `out/module.ts`, but I didn't check that `tsconfig.json` actually includes the `out` folder.
